behavior: Client termination durably cancels future appointments and reminders, releases reserved package credits without cancellation fees, and blocks future clinical claims.
Canceled appointment and clinical records remain intact; a separate unlinked Assigned Available room event can be opened for in-person booking.
Group sessions retain other clients; the final departing client cancels the shared appointment and room.
Stopped client plans and canceled meeting series cannot silently renew; cancellation, renewal, and calendar synchronization share locks.
New room bookings and series must start within six office-local calendar weeks; recurring tails can extend through the one-year record window.
New one-time meetings are capped at one year; ongoing recurring meetings default to a rolling year.
Supervision supports single-occurrence and this-and-all-future cancellation, including held occurrences and already-canceled anchors.
Biweekly counts exclude off-weeks. New Monthly office assignments use calendar dates with month-end clamping; migrated four-week commitments retain their dates.

validation.production_frontend_build: passed (8 GB Node heap; existing large-chunk warnings)

deployment.prerequisite: 1559_recurring_schedule_window.sql and the existing recurring scheduling branch migrations
deployment.existing_anonymous_legacy_bookings: No client identity is inferred; the migration does not cancel unattributed room reservations.
